brief: Evaluate an array and return get_assignable_value of it
description: Evaluate an array value and return get_assignable_value of it (a managed copy of an unmanaged or permanent array, or the same managed array). Remaining explicit wrap_literal_array() calls; the compiler no longer emits this. Not normal author surface.

parameters.description: Array to evaluate (typically a constant array literal).
parameters.name: array

returns.description: An array that is safe to mutate and store. It lasts for the caller.
